title: Managing National Food Stockpile while Being Mindful of Wastage, Nutritional Value and Food Prices
what_it_is: Managing National Food Stockpile while Being Mindful of Wastage, Nutritional Value and Food Prices

sections.label: Government food stockpiles with private sector
sections.summary: The Government works with the private sector to maintain stockpiles of essential food items, including rice, frozen protein and canned vegetables, and bears the operating cost.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The Government works closely with the private sector to maintain adequate stockpiles of essential food items to serve as a buffer to ensure that our basic needs can be met in times of food supply disruptions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Our national stockpiles consist of a range of items including rice, frozen protein and canned vegetables.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The Government works closely with the private sector to optimise our stockpiling operations, including to ensure proper storage conditions and conduct regular churning to ensure that the stockpiled food is safe for consumption while minimising food wastage.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The operating cost of maintaining the Government-owned food stockpiles is borne by the Government.

sections.label: Stockpiles not for food prices
sections.summary: Stockpiles are not meant to influence food prices or flood the market, and the main private sector stockpile is rice.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Our stockpiles are not meant to be a mechanism to influence food prices, not to find ways to flood the market so that prices of chicken or other meats come down.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Ultimately, today, the main stockpile that involves private sector stocking would be just rice.

sections.label: Distinguishing stockpiling from price mechanisms
sections.summary: Stockpiling is done efficiently without disrupting the market, and stockpiles should not be used to influence food prices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: And therefore, we try to do it efficiently as much as possible without having to disrupt the market.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We should distinguish between stockpiling and price mechanisms for food and other supplies, because we should not then mess around with our stockpiles to try to influence food prices across Singapore.

sections.label: SFA food quality and safety audits
sections.summary: SFA does regular audits on food quality and safety to ensure food is safe for consumption when drawn down.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: On the food audits, as I said in my reply, SFA does regular audits on the food quality and food safety to ensure that the food, when drawn down, is safe for consumption.
